events.title: Dutch Bros to Post Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
events.body: BROS is set to report Q1 2026 on May 6, with EPS and revenues seen rising on same-shop gains and new shops, while higher coffee costs weigh.

events.title: Dutch Bros (BROS) Q1 Earnings Preview: What You Should Know Beyond the Headline Estimates
events.body: Get a deeper insight into the potential performance of Dutch Bros (BROS) for the quarter ended March 2026 by going beyond Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimates and examining the estimates for some of its key metrics.
